comments.text: Hi Josh, if and how does the International Patient Access (IPA) fit into this framework?
comments.html: Hi Josh, if and how does the International Patient Access (IPA) fit into this framework?

comments.text: IPA defines a way for apps to connect to one site at a time, and it involves an OAuth flow where the patient signs into that site to approve access. This article is about a pattern for apps that need to connect to many sites on the basis of a single ID verification + authorization ceremony.
